great-sand-dunes.dogs: Leashed, 6 ft max. Permitted on Mosca Pass Trail (Preserve), Dunes Overlook Trail, Medano Pass Primitive Road, main use areas and Pinon Flats Campground. NOT permitted off the Dunes Overlook Trail, in the dunefield beyond the first high ridge, north of Point of No Return, or on Sand Ramp Trail.
great-sand-dunes.dogs_source_quote: Pets are permitted on leash on Montville Trail and Mosca Pass Trail. Please be sure to clean up after your pet.

salida-buenavista.dogs: Only one of these has a published rule: Hecla Junction sits in the Arkansas Headwaters Recreation Area, where Colorado Parks and Wildlife lists leashed dogs as permitted — the Forest Service publishes nothing for Waterdog Lakes or Old Monarch Pass, and Salida's code is contradictory (7-5-250 allows a leashed dog in any public space, 7-5-220 calls a dog in an undesignated part of a park a nuisance), so the town and Tenderfoot trails stay unknown.

wind-river.dogs: Bridger-Teton's only dog order is somewhere else entirely — named Jackson Ranger District trails, 1 Dec to 1 May — and neither the Greater Yellowstone wilderness order (GYCC-7) nor any Pinedale Ranger District page says anything about dogs, so all four Wind River routes are unstated rather than confirmed.
wind-river.dogs_source_quote: Possessing a dog in or on the Described Areas and Described Trails unless it is tethered by a leash not longer than six feet.

bozeman.dogs: Gallatin Valley Land Trust publishes a dog rule on each Main Street to the Mountains trail page: off-leash on Drinking Horse Mountain and the College M, on-leash on Triple Tree and the Gallagator — only Grotto Falls, which is Custer Gallatin NF in Hyalite, has no published rule.

long-beach.dogs: The Discovery Trail runs into Cape Disappointment State Park, and Washington State Parks lists the park's rule as dogs allowed on leash; the City of Long Beach publishes nothing extra for its half of the trail.

white-salmon.dogs: Catherine Creek trailhead: "Dogs on leash in Catherine Creek planning area year round. Dogs on leash in Coyote/Burdoin planning areas December 1st through June 30th." Leash requirements in the Gorge are set site by site rather than area-wide.
white-salmon.dogs_source_quote: Do not cross the fencing near the natural arch, as the area is closed to protect sensitive resources. Bikes are prohibited on this trail. Horses prohibited on this trail. Dogs must be on leash year round.

newport.dogs: BLM: "Pets may accompany visitors on trails and walkways except near the lighthouse and in the Cobble Beach tide pools", and "must remain on a 6-foot leash at all times". Therapy animals and pets are not allowed inside buildings.
newport.dogs_source_quote: Pets may accompany visitors on trails and walkways except near the lighthouse and in the Cobble Beach tide pools.

lone-pine.dogs: BLM Bishop Field Office publishes no pet rule for the Alabama Hills at all — not on the scenic-area page, not on the Mobius Arch trail page, not in the 2022 brochure or the map and guide — so this is unknown, not permitted.

imperial-dam.dogs: Imperial National Wildlife Refuge allows pets on leash, which covers the Painted Desert Trail; BLM's Betty's Kitchen page addresses only service dogs, so a pet dog there is unstated.
imperial-dam.dogs_source_quote: Pets must be on a leash, unless being actively used for lawful hunting purposes.

grand-canyon.dogs: SPLIT BY THE RIM. NPS: "Leashed pets are allowed on trails above the rim" on the South Rim, and "Pets are not permitted below the rim (on inner canyon trails)." So the Rim Trail is open to the dog and every descent is not.
grand-canyon.dogs_source_quote: Leashed pets are allowed on trails above the rim, Mather Campground, Desert View Campground, Trailer Village, and throughout developed areas.

ouray.dogs: Mount Sneffels Wilderness order: dogs are prohibited if "(i) off leash; (ii) not under the direct verbal control of the dog's owner or handler at all times; or (iii) disturbing or damaging wildlife, other animals, people or property". On leash or under verbal control the dog is legal.

durango.dogs: Leashed on both — the City of Durango says leashed dogs are welcome throughout its parks, open space and trails, and a leash is the law inside city limits; voice control applies only on the federal land outside town, not on Horse Gulch.
durango.dogs_source_quote: Leashed dogs are welcome throughout Durango's parks, open space and trails
